messages:
amanda: FYI queue for reserved A100s in us-west2 just jumped — 18 pending requests, avg lead time ~21 days. We have an enterprise P0 asking for 12 GPUs in 48h. :grimacing:

jordan: oof. are these reserved capacity requests or on-demand fulfillment?

amanda: reserved. customers requesting Reserved/Dedicated pools. On-demand is available but cost hits margins. Current pool utilization is 98% in us-west2.

sai: any scheduled maintenance affecting capacity? deploy-bot: Planned HW maintenance for us-west2 GPU clusters on 1819220000-1819250000 may reduce available inventory by ~10%.

amanda: thanks deploy-bot — that makes the next 72h worse.

marta: if we move them to on-demand, finance needs cost delta. approximate numbers?

sai: quick calc: 12 x A100 on-demand ~ $7.5k/day => ~$225k/month. Reserved 6m commit estimate saving ~60% -> ~$90k/month. Spot mix could cut to ~$45k/month but we risk evictions.

jordan: can we offer cross-region fallback? e.g., route some requests to us-central1 or eu-west1 where we have spare capacity? performance SLAs are tight though.

amanda: us-central1 has ~16 free A100s but higher tail latencies for that customer due to egress and privacy rules. EU is out — data residency.

sai: short-term workaround: 1) temporary 6-month commit for 12 A100s in us-central1 with network peering + encrypted egress to meet privacy; 2) enable spot fallback for non-critical jobs; 3) submit expedited support ticket to cloud to increase quota in us-west2.

liam: what's the delta in latency/egress cost if we route to us-central1? we need numbers for the customer message.

sai: rough: +30ms p95, egress ~$0.02/GB extra, estimate $1.2k/month on their typical traffic.

amanda: customer asked for 48h turnaround. Could we offer a temporary hybrid: 8 GPUs reserved in us-west2 (move up queue with escalation), 4 committed in us-central1 for burst?

jordan: escalation path? ops team can mark the reservation as urgent but we need exec approval for cross-region commit. @marta can you sign off provisional budget? :pray:

marta: I can approve up to $60k one-time interim if PM + AE confirm financials and customer signs an expedited commit. need a one-pager.

amanda: copying AE for context. I'll draft one-pager.

sai: if we do 4 A100 in us-central1 for 6 months, estimated commit cost ~$36k (6m). Savings vs on-demand ~ $54k over 6 months. Numbers for the one-pager.

opsteam-bot: Capacity alert: reserved_pool_utilization/us-west2 = 98% (threshold 90%). Pending_reservations = 18.

liam: also note runtime flavors: some models need 80GB mem variants; if we spill to us-central1 we must ensure same sku/driver versions. ops check?

amanda: confirmed — images and drivers match across regions for the A100 SKU.

jordan: what's the risk if we move forward with 6m commit? does it block us for larger enterprise deals?

sai: it's a tradeoff. 6m gives us flexibility vs 12m. We can include a clause: allow reallocation across regions with 48h notice. Legal needs to check.

amanda: action items: 1) I will open an expedited quota increase ticket with cloud provider (include deploy logs & opsteam-bot alert). 2) Sai will prepare cost appendix for 4x A100 us-central1 6m commit. 3) Jordan will check model SKU parity and validate perf impact. 4) Marta will provision interim budget approval doc. 5) Liam to update customer-facing note.

amanda: opening ticket now: `SupportTicket#create: priority=P0, subject="Expedite GPU capacity - us-west2 reserved fulfillment"`, attaching queue dump and maintenance window.

jordan: I'll run quick perf tests across regions and post results here.

sai: I'll also draft two financial scenarios: (A) 6m 4A100 us-central1 + 8 reserved us-west2 (when fulfilled) (B) 12 A100 6m us-central1 only. include monthly run-rate, one-time setup, and projected savings.

marta: please include an explicit cancellation fallback and reallocation policy for finance.

amanda: noted. timeline: need customer answer within 24h. I'll ping PM + AE and post back with their OK.

deploy-bot: Note: If we escalate physical reservation, fulfillment ETA depends on vendor stock. Opening support case does not guarantee immediate allocation.

amanda: understood. still pushing. will update thread. :wave:

(last) amanda: quick update — cloud support responded, asked for exact instance IDs and business justification. putting together and will attach in thread.
